question: According to Revelation 1, in what order was this revelation passed along?
options: Jesus gave it to God, God sent an angel, the angel told John
God gave it to Jesus, Jesus sent his angel, the angel made it known to John
An angel gave it to John, John gave it to Jesus, Jesus gave it to the churches
John received it from Moses, then wrote it for the churches
explanation: God gave the revelation to Jesus Christ, who made it known by sending his angel to his servant John.
